dict.string: OpenChat reads your calendar so agents can help with schedules. If you allow editing, agents may propose event changes that you confirm in the app before anything is saved.
OpenChat uses the camera so agents can analyze photos or documents you capture.

OpenChat reads only fitness-related Apple Health data you enable—steps, heart rate, workouts, energy, exercise time, walking/running distance, and sleep—for coaching insights. It does not access clinical records. This is not medical advice.
OpenChat does not write health data to Apple Health. This string is required because the app references HealthKit for read-only fitness coaching features.
OpenChat uses the microphone for voice input and transcription when you enable it.
OpenChat saves images to your photo library when you choose Save to Photos.
OpenChat accesses photos you select so agents can analyze images.
